budgets.rationale: Isolated 720p grid detection is low-noise relative to full cleanup and already has dedicated benchmark coverage.
Isolated 1080p grid detection scales predictably and should catch major regressions in the detector hot path.
The deterministic Step 1B and Step 1G fixture matrix provides a low-noise advisory guard while robust inference remains opt-in.
The frozen pre-change Step 1M matrix measured 84.33 ms locally; a 100 ms advisory ceiling allows normal host variance while guarding the new opt-in low-evidence path.
Full cleanup includes more phases and remains advisory until repeated CI data confirms noise levels.
Large sheet cleanup depends on multiple phases and host performance, so it stays advisory for now.
